title.description: Site title, shown in the header and in page titles.

baseUrl.description: Absolute http(s) origin the site is served from, without a path. Used for canonical URLs, the sitemap and `robots.txt`.

favicon.description: Site icon: a .svg, .png or .ico file below the site directory.

appleTouchIcon.description: Apple touch icon: a .png file below the site directory (180x180 recommended).

holder.description: Name shown in the copyright line.

rights.description: Rights statement after the holder, e.g. "All rights reserved."

copyright.description: Copyright line in the footer; the years run from the earliest year of a published item to the current year.

label.description: Name of the section in the menu, and heading of its page unless the section's index.md has a title.

noun.description: Singular and plural name of one item, e.g. [post, posts]; used in texts such as "All posts" and "No posts yet".

taxonomies.description: Taxonomies the section uses: categories and/or tags. Each gets a term index and a page per term. The first declared one fills the menu when `menu` is `taxonomy`.

menu.description: What the menu group of the section lists besides its "All ..." link: `taxonomy` (the terms of the first declared taxonomy), `items` (the items by title) or `none` (a plain link, no group).

layout.description: How the section page shows its items: `stream` (full articles, further ones loaded while scrolling), `cards` (a grid of cards) or `list` (titles and dates).

initial.description: Items rendered on the section page at first load.

batch.description: Items revealed per further step while scrolling.

stream.description: Progressive loading of a `stream` section. Required for the `stream` layout, forbidden for the others.

sections.description: Sections of the site. Each key is a directory below the site directory and the first URL segment of its items; it must be a clean slug.

menu.description: Menu entries after the implicit Home: names of sections or of top-level pages, in order.

latest.description: Key of the section whose newest items are shown (by published date).

featured.description: Key of the section whose items with `featured: true` are shown, newest first.

home.description: Blocks of the home page, in order. Each has either `latest` or `featured`, plus `count`.
